text: Pechersk is covered. The dragon is safe. So is the hangar. Though the doorway is a little wider now.
We’ll get the doors fixed. Word from Odesa is that eight helicopters are coming in off the sea. A fisherman on the pier counted them.
Will they hover before firing again?

Yes, they hover for a moment before they fire. Even after a rocket is in the air, your dragon can still shoot it down. There’s a patch in the achievement hall for intercepting twenty helicopter rockets, by the way.
If you see that fisherman, tell him we’ll try not to scare off the fish. Can’t speak for the helicopters.
